APP_ENV=local
APP_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3001
BILLING_MODE=mock

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:54321
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=local-publishable-key
SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY=local-service-role-key

REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTHORIZATION=Bearer local-revenuecat-webhook-secret
REVENUECAT_SECRET_API_KEY=
REVENUECAT_ENTITLEMENT_ID=pro
REVENUECAT_PURCHASE_LINK_SANDBOX=https://pay.rev.cat/sandbox-token
REVENUECAT_PURCHASE_LINK_LIVE=

# Apple OAuth (Supabase Auth provider config)
SUPABASE_AUTH_APPLE_CLIENT_ID=
SUPABASE_AUTH_APPLE_SECRET=

# Google OAuth (Supabase Auth provider config)
SUPABASE_AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=
SUPABASE_AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET=

# Security (required in production)
CF_VERIFY_SECRET=
REDIS_URL=
